title: Canonical DVR transport of strict quotient reduction and augmentation
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an adic datum d on its valuation ring, a scheme T, a coefficient model C of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models], a calculus S of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and a normalized limit model M of [lem-sf-open-dvr-limit-comparison]. The completed-adic quotient reduction after C is naturally isomorphic to the scalar-restricted S reduction tower. On every flat-term K-flat Q it is computed by one strict complex of towers B and augmentation from the constant Q, with the prescribed pure-tensor normalization, reduction-counit equation and representative total-limit equation. After the tower comparison and the fixed M.rlim comparison, the actual completed-adic completion unit equals C applied to the actual S adjunction unit. These are exactly the tower, representative and unit clauses of OpenDvrAugmentedReductionComparison; no completeness predicate, regular generator or open immersion is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6E and 0941; strict tensor augmentation and derived constant/limit unit.

proof.text: Apply the strict quotient transport theorem to C and S. It gives the natural reduction-tower isomorphism and, on each flat-term K-flat representative, B, a, kappa, e, tau and their four ordinary/derived augmentation equations. No total coefficient-limit comparison is part of that theorem.

Extend the reconstruction-completion-unit normalization to every complex after composing with the reduction counit. Build the counit and right-derived-limit comparisons as natural transformations on cochains, including all localization factors. The normalization is immediate on a K-flat complex by canceling its invertible counit. For an arbitrary complex choose a K-flat resolution, use naturality of the two composites, and cancel its localized quasi-isomorphism.

On a flat-term K-flat source Q, take the strict representative B and M.limit_model B. Compare the two ordinary maps into C of lim B by the preserved limit cone: M fixes sigma on projections, tau fixes the quotient augmentation, and the constant/limit unit identity gives the same components. Localize this equality. The reduction-counit equation and the normalization from the previous step identify the completed-adic composite, and naturality of M.rlim and its limit_model formula identify it with C of the representative scalar adjunction unit. Cancel the isomorphism induced by e.

The completed-adic composite and C of S.adjunction.unit are natural transformations on the source derived category. Every object has a flat-term K-flat representative by essential surjectivity of localization and a K-flat resolution. Transport the equality on that representative along its derived isomorphism and cancel its image under C. Assemble tower, representative and the resulting unit equation. The proved site/monoidal tensor isomorphism converts the resolution theorem’s flatness predicate to IsFlatOnSite.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6E and 0941; agent assembly of strict tensor normalization with the fixed M.limit_model, using K-flat resolution naturality.

theorem openDvrAugmentedReductionComparison
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (C : OpenDvrCoefficientModel l E d T)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E T)
    (M : OpenDvrLimitComparison l E C) :
    Nonempty (OpenDvrAugmentedReductionComparison l E C S M)
